name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 7 visits over 62 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2026-04-27, at wavelengths from 1.66 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
